I3.findings: 1) SENT SCAN WINDOW (line 40): 'or back to the start of the latest run whose record isn't Completed if that is earlier'. Read literally, the latest record that isn't Completed is the 17:38 run's own Started record, or the 16:38 Skipped record. Neither is the 09:38 crash, so the clause never reaches back to the crashed run. Here the plain 24-hour window (from 26 Oct 17:38 JST) covers the 10:41 send, so the outcome is right. A lock held more than 24 hours would push a crashed send out of the scan. The per-action pre-send check (Sent 'since the action was raised') would still stop a resend, but only once the action is collected. Suggested fix: 'the earliest run record still Started (not Completed, Skipped or Failed)', excluding this run. 2) Timing conflict in the scenario: the text says the reply went 'at 09:41', but the sent-mail data says 2026-10-27T10:41+09:00, and a 09:41 send can't answer a 09:55 inbound. I used 10:41 JST. That means the crashed 09:38 run was still sending at 10:41, after the 10:38 run had skipped. 3) The crashed reply HYP-I3-SENT has Cc Akshay only. Revenue mail must also copy Jaya and Sarika (SENDING; STEP 1b). The match rule correctly forbids a resend, but nothing tells the recovering run to notice or report the missing copies, or to WhatsApp Jaya. It should be reported. 4) The 09:38 run record stays Started forever. Nothing makes a later run or the runbook close it (Failed or Partial). That also leaves the 'latest record not Completed' anchor ill-defined. 5) The 10:38 and 16:38 SLOW work was skipped, and the 17:38 run is FAST only, so 27 Oct gets no SLOW work. It 'stays due' until the 28 Oct 10:38 run. That matches the intent but isn't said in the prompt. 6) Whether a run whose only action was completed by match is Completed or No-op is a judgment call. I read 'a held or blocked action is handled' plus 'completed by match' as Completed.

SKIP.findings: 1) Writing the Notion Activity needs the Activities property and option names. NOTION DATA says 'Fetch each data source once to confirm property and option names', but LOCK step 3 says 'no other read'. Step 3 is the specific rule, so the run writes blind. A schema mismatch would make the create fail, and the prompt doesn't say what a Skipped run does then (retry once? report where?). 2) RUN RECORD's 'Unclear create response: query that Source ID first and reuse its row' is the only read allowed after a held lock. It is conditional, and I counted it as part of the record write. 3) Loading the Notion tool schema with ToolSearch is tool loading, not a data read, but the prompt doesn't classify it. 4) The Summary format comes from the Started template ('Run zoya <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM> JST'), joined with step 3's text.
